scripts.text:
[Jiwon]
I think we're really
fortunate to be able to
live in such a beautiful
and peaceful city like this.
scripts.translation:
[智元]
能住在這麼美麗又寧靜的城市裡，我覺得我們真幸運。

scripts.text:
[Jiwon]
It's just so nice to
have this pleasant weather,
these lush gardens and to
meet all of these kind people.
Lighthalzen is like Asgard
in Midgard, heaven on earth~
scripts.translation:
[智元]
天氣宜人，花園鬱鬱蔥蔥，身邊的人也這麼友善，真好。
裡希塔樂鎮簡直就是米德加爾特的阿斯加德，人間天堂~

scripts.text:
[Samnang]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
It gets harder for me
to move around as I get
older. That's understandable
for an elderly person, right?
scripts.translation:
[薩姆南]
^333333*唉...*^000000
年紀越大，行動越不方便。人老了，這也正常，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Samnang]
Just the other day, these
hoodlums in black suits
were yelling at me to get out
of their way. But of course,
I didn't move quickly enough.
So what did they do to me?
scripts.translation:
[薩姆南]
前幾天，幾個穿黑西裝的混混衝我嚷嚷，叫我讓路。可我這把年紀，哪能一下就挪開？
你猜，他們對我做了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Samnang]
They punched me.
Right in the womb!
I know that I'm not
pregnant, but that's
besides the point. Never hit
a lady, especially an old one!
scripts.translation:
[薩姆南]
他們竟然打了我一拳，就打在小腹上！我知道自己沒懷孕，可這不是重點。
哪能打女人，尤其是我這樣的老太太！

scripts.text:
[Ruth]
Sweety, isn't it
nice to be together
under this beautiful
sunlight? It's perfect
for our date. Ahhhh~
scripts.translation:
[露絲]
親愛的，在這麼美的陽光下，跟你待在一起，是不是特別好？最適合我們約會了。
啊~

scripts.text:
[Ruth]
I'm so happy to be
with you. I feel like
I'm just melting with
happiness. Oh, I love
you so much, Oyoung.
scripts.translation:
[露絲]
和你在一起，我好開心，簡直要被幸福融化了。
哦，五榮，我好愛你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whoa...
This couple is
really headed for
Cloud 9, aren't they?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇...這對情侶簡直幸福得飄上天了，是吧？

scripts.text:
[Oyoung]
Girl, you look like
you're comin' down with
the love bug. But there's
only one prescription for
this ailment, ooooh yeah...
scripts.translation:
[五榮]
寶貝，你好像染上相思病了。可這病只有一種解藥，哦，沒錯...

scripts.text:
[Oyoung]
You need yo'self
your daily dose of
vitamin O-YOUNG.
And your lips look like
they got vitamin deficiency.
I better take care of that~
scripts.translation:
[五榮]
你得每天補充一劑“五榮維生素”。你的嘴唇看起來也缺維生素了，我得幫你好好補補~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sweet Sister!
I don't know what's
more mind boggling--
The fact that he used
that line or the fact that
it's actually working...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪！我真不知道哪件事更離譜——他竟然說得出這種情話，還是這種情話竟然管用...

scripts.text:
[Kariya]
I think ''Lighthalzen'' is
supposed to mean ''crest of
light,'' though I hear that this
city was actually named after
somebody. Who knows for sure?
scripts.translation:
[苅谷]
“裡希塔樂鎮”好像是“光輝之冠”的意思。不過，也聽說這座城其實是以某個人的名字命名的。
誰知道究竟是怎麼回事呢？

scripts.text:
[Kariya]
Still, it's a fitting
name for the wealthiest
and most luxurious city in
all the Schwarzwald Republic.
So how do you like this place?
scripts.translation:
[苅谷]
不過，這名字確實配得上修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國最富裕、最奢華的城市。
你覺得這裡怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Sung]
When I grow up, I want
to become such a great
person that they'll make
a statue of me, just like
those statues over there.
scripts.translation:
[成]
等我長大了，也要成為偉大的人，讓大家給我立座雕像，就像那邊那些一樣。

scripts.text:
[Sung]
Then people would be like,
''Hey yo. That statue. That
guy must have been great!''
Just thinking about that
makes me feel so good!
scripts.translation:
[成]
到時候，人們就會說：“嘿，看那座雕像！那個人一定很了不起！”
光想想就好開心！

scripts.text:
[Sung]
That's it. I'm gonna
grow up as soon as I can.
Ooh, and I better grow tall
and handsome so my statue
will be even more awesome.
Yeah. Yeah, good idea, Sung...
scripts.translation:
[成]
決定了，我要趕快長大！還得長得又高又帥，這樣我的雕像就更威風了。
嗯，嗯，好主意，成...

scripts.text:
[Sameer]
There are too many
loving couples in this city.
Cuddling and kissing and
hugging and necking. It's...
It's utterly distasteful.
scripts.translation:
[薩米爾]
這城裡恩恩愛愛的情侶太多了，摟摟抱抱、親親我我的。
真是...真是令人作嘔。

scripts.text:
[Sameer]
I can't believe the
indecency I see everyday
near my own home. Don't
they know better than to be
so affectionate in places
where the public can see them?!
scripts.translation:
[薩米爾]
每天在自家附近都能看到這種不雅行為，簡直難以置信。
他們難道不知道，在大庭廣眾之下這麼親熱，太不像話了嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Sameer]
Fortunately for the
world, I'm a bulwark
of morality. In fact, I have
no need for a woman. All
I need are my ship models,
teen novels and dominoes.
scripts.translation:
[薩米爾]
幸好，這世界還有我這樣堅守道德的人。我根本不需要女人，只要有船模、青少年小說和多米諾骨牌就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Sameer]
I'm a completely well
adjusted individual, which
is why the authorities should
listen to me when I tell them
to arrest couples for indecency!
Hand holding. Have they no shame?!
scripts.translation:
[薩米爾]
我可是個完全正常的人，所以，當局就該聽我的，把那些舉止不雅的情侶抓起來！
竟然牽手。他們就不知羞恥嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Janice]
Oh no, I think I got
lost again. The roads
here are so confusing!
I've lived here for such
a long time and I still
can't find my way around...
scripts.translation:
[珍妮絲]
哎呀，我好像又迷路了。這裡的路太難認了！
住了這麼久，我還是分不清方向...

scripts.text:
[Elmer Keays]
Walking side by side
with you like this reminds
me of the old days. Back
then, everyone was jealous
that I had such a beautiful
woman by my side. Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[埃爾默·基斯]
像這樣跟你並肩散步，就讓我想起從前。那時，大家都羨慕我，身邊有個這麼漂亮的女人。
呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Elmer Keays]
You're still the most
precious sight to these
old eyes, my dear. I'm
really lucky to be with you.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾默·基斯]
親愛的，我這雙老眼裡，你依然是最珍貴的風景。能與你相伴，我真幸運。

scripts.text:
[Margie Keays]
Oh darling, the
weather is so nice
and pleasant today.
I'm really glad we
decided to go take
a walk together~
scripts.translation:
[瑪吉·基斯]
哦，親愛的，今天天氣真好，舒服極了。幸好我們決定一起出來散步~

scripts.text:
[Maivi]
...

[Maivi]
Ah...
I just had the nicest
nap. This nice weather
never fails to relax me.
The air here is so clean,
not like that Einbroch~
scripts.translation:
[麥維]
啊...剛才這一覺睡得真舒服。好天氣總能讓人放鬆。
這裡的空氣真乾淨，哪像艾音布羅克~

scripts.text:
[Maivi]
This clean, pristine
environment is all thanks
to the Rekenber Corporation.
It's incredible what they can
do with technology now, isn't
it? Ahhh, it's so peaceful~
scripts.translation:
[麥維]
這麼潔淨的環境，全靠雷肯貝爾公司。如今他們用科技能做到的事，真是不可思議，對吧？
啊，真寧靜~

scripts.text:
[Klaubis]
Excuse me, but are you
a tourist? Well, welcome
to Lighthalzen! This city
has everything we need,
but it can be a little too
quiet and uneventful here.
scripts.translation:
[克勞比斯]
請問，你是遊客嗎？歡迎來到裡希塔樂鎮！
這裡什麼都有，就是有時候太安靜，沒什麼新鮮事。

scripts.text: Have you lived in here long?
scripts.translation: 你在這裡住很久了嗎？

scripts.text: I agree.
scripts.translation: 我也這麼覺得

scripts.text: Have you heard about the serial killer?
scripts.translation: 你聽說過連環殺手嗎？

scripts.text:
[Klaubis]
Yes, our family has
lived in this city for a
long time, starting with
my great grandfather. Let's
see, my family's been here
for about two hundred years.
scripts.translation:
[克勞比斯]
是啊，從我曾祖父那一輩起，我們家就在這座城裡生活了。
讓我想想，大概有兩百年了吧。

scripts.text:
[Klaubis]
You'd be surprised how
many people stay in their
hometowns. Even if you do
leave, though, you can always
come back. It wouldn't be your hometown if you couldn't, right?
scripts.translation:
[克勞比斯]
一直留在家鄉的人，多得會讓你吃驚。就算離開了，也總能回來。
要是連回來都不行，還算什麼家鄉，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Klaubis]
Yes, the atmosphere
can get pretty listless
around here. But still,
there are plenty of nice
sights to enjoy here in
Lighthalzen, so look around~
scripts.translation:
[克勞比斯]
是啊，這裡有時候確實有點沉悶。不過，裡希塔樂鎮還是有不少美景，四處逛逛吧~

scripts.text:
[Klaubis]
You mean the Serial
Axe Murderer? I thought
that was an old ghost story.
Hm. I think that lady inside
the Weapon Shop would
know more about that tale...
scripts.translation:
[克勞比斯]
你說那個連環斧頭殺人犯？我還以為那只是個老鬼故事。
嗯，武器店裡的那位女士，應該更瞭解這個故事...

scripts.text:
[Sigmund Ting]
You know what I noticed?
The guards at the border
to the slum seem distracted
sometimes. I made use of one
of their less attentive moments
and basically jumped the fence!
scripts.translation:
[西格蒙德·丁]
你知道我發現了什麼嗎？貧民窟入口的衛兵，有時候會走神。
我就趁他們沒留意，翻過圍欄進去了！

scripts.text:
[Sigmund Ting]
But once I was in the 
slums, I was pretty bored.
There really isn't much to
do there. Which makes me
wonder... Why guard it?
scripts.translation:
[西格蒙德·丁]
不過，進了貧民窟以後，才發現挺無聊的，沒什麼可乾的。
這就讓我納悶了...幹嗎還要派人守著？

scripts.text:
[Joyce]
I can sense your
longing look within
the depths of my heart,
beating faster and faster
with a feverish passion~
scripts.translation:
[喬伊斯]
你的目光滿含渴望，我內心深處都能感受到。我的心隨著這熾熱的激情，跳得越來越快~

scripts.text:
[Dan Song]
Those eyes of yours...
So pure and so deep,
like glimmering pools
of light. So, so beautiful...
scripts.translation:
[丹·宋]
你的雙眼...那麼清澈，那麼深邃，宛如閃著微光的水潭。
真美，真美...

scripts.text:
[Collins]
I really wish that my
son will be able to join
the Rekenber Corporation.
They certainly provide the
best jobs in Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[柯林斯]
我真希望我兒子能加入裡希塔樂鎮的雷肯貝爾公司。
他們那裡的工作待遇絕對是全鎮最好的。

scripts.text:
[Collins]
Although they're a large,
major corporation, it's
almost impossible to get
employed by them. How
do people get hired there
in the first place anyway?
scripts.translation:
[柯林斯]
他們雖是大公司，可想進去工作卻難如登天。別人到底是怎麼應聘上的呢？

scripts.text:
[Villagomez]
I just step out to get
a haircut and now I'm
lost. Boy oh boy, I hope
I don't keep my family
waiting. ^333333*Sigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[維拉戈梅斯]
我不過出門剪個頭髮，竟然就迷路了。唉，希望別讓家裡人等太久。^333333*唉...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Kemp]
Have you ever seen the
people who work in that big
corporation over there? I think
their employees are all a bit
off kilter for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[肯普]
你見過那邊大公司的員工嗎？不知怎麼回事，我總覺得他們都有點不對勁。

scripts.text:
[Kemp]
I haven't been there
myself, but something
strange is happening with
all the people who work there.
scripts.translation:
[肯普]
我自己沒去過那裡，但在那家公司工作的人身上似乎發生了一些奇怪的事情。

scripts.text:
[Mauro]
The youth in this city
have no appreciation for
their elders. I've worked
so hard to help build this
city for so many years and
this is the thanks I get?
scripts.translation:
[毛羅]
這座城市的年輕人根本不尊重長輩。
我辛苦多年幫助建設這座城市，得到的卻是這種回報？

scripts.text:
[Mauro]
Bah! If it weren't for
us, Lighthalzen wouldn't
be as prosperous as it is
today! Those kids don't
know that they owe their
lives of luxury to us...
scripts.translation:
[毛羅]
哼！要不是我們，裡希塔樂鎮今天不會這麼繁榮！
那些孩子根本不知道他們的富裕生活是我們給的...

scripts.text:
[Sefith]
Good looks. Intelligence.
Excellent manners. A strong,
manly chin and overpowering,
piercing eyes. Perfectly balanced passion and charisma. All the
good things that ladies want.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲斯]
相貌英俊，頭腦聰明，舉止優雅。下巴稜角分明，充滿男子氣概，目光銳利，攝人心魄。
熱情與魅力恰到好處。女人想要的一切優點，都齊了。

scripts.text:
[Sefith]
But enough about me. Let's
discuss how sorry I should
feel for any other man living
in Lighthalzen. They don't hold
a candle to my studliness~
scripts.translation:
[塞菲斯]
好了，不說我了。聊聊裡希塔樂鎮其他男人有多值得同情吧。
論男性魅力，他們跟我根本沒法比~

scripts.text:
[Jade]
I've heard that there's a
strange kingdom out there
that's basically ruled by
magic and swords, where
adventurers are enlisted
for the greater good.
scripts.translation:
[傑德]
聽說外面有個奇怪的王國，主要依靠劍與魔法來治理，還會招募冒險者為大家謀福祉。

scripts.text:
[Jade]
So are you from
Rune-Midgarts?
What do you think
of our city with its
advanced technology
and economy? Huh...
scripts.translation:
[傑德]
你是從盧恩·米德加茲來的嗎？我們這座城科技先進，經濟發達，你覺得怎麼樣？嗯...

scripts.text:
[Jade]
Someday, I'd like
to go visit the land
where you came from.
It sounds so fantastic
and romantic in a way...
scripts.translation:
[傑德]
將來有機會，我也想去你的家鄉看看。聽起來那麼奇幻，又有幾分浪漫...

scripts.text:
[Khramptd]
The land around here
is some pretty expensive
property. Yes, it's perfect
for building my awesome palace!
I don't have enough funds at the
moment, but the day will come~
scripts.translation:
[克拉姆普特]
這一帶的地價可不便宜。不過，正適合建造我那氣派的宮殿！
眼下錢還不夠，但那一天總會來的~

scripts.text:
[Maggie]
Sure, I sell a lot
of flowers here, but
the lease that this city
makes me pay cuts into
my profits. It's almost not
worth renting this property.
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬]
我在這裡賣的花是挺多，可交給城裡的租金，把利潤吃掉了不少。租下這個地方，幾乎都不划算了。

scripts.text:
[Maggie]
I pay such a ridiculous
amount for the lease and the
laws here won't let me raise
the price of my flowers. Why
are the city officials so greedy?
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬]
租金高得離譜，這裡的法律還不許我提高花價。城裡的官員怎麼就這麼貪心？

scripts.text:
[Wallace]
......
That lady, working
for that one company,
Kafra, Mafra or whatever.
She certainly is very charming.
scripts.translation:
[華萊士]
......
在那家公司工作的姑娘，就是卡普拉、馬普拉什麼的那個公司。她可真迷人。

scripts.text:
[Wallace]
Now, if I were
thirty years younger...
Wait! I'm a rich and powerful
man. I could ask her out now.
Hm? What's that look for?
scripts.translation:
[華萊士]
要是我年輕三十歲...等等！我有錢有勢，現在也能約她出來呀。
嗯？你那是什麼眼神？

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Hello youngster~
Would you like to
make a donation
to help the hungry?
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯]
你好，年輕人~
你願意捐款幫助飢餓的人嗎？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Now, you can donate 1 to
30,000 zeny that will be used
to support the poor and feed
starving children. If you wish
to cancel, please enter ''0.''
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯]
你可以捐 1 到 30,000 Zeny，用於救濟窮人，讓捱餓的孩子們吃飽。
想取消的話，請輸入“0”。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Please enter a value
from 1 to 30,000 in
order to make a donation
to the needy, youngster.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯]
年輕人，請輸入 1 到 30,000 之間的金額，為有需要的人捐款。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
How disappointing,
but I'm sure you have
your reasons. Well, when
you can afford to give to
the needy, you're welcome
to come back at any time.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯]
真讓人失望，不過，相信你也有自己的難處。等你有餘力幫助窮人時，歡迎隨時再來。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Thank you so much
for your {0} zeny donation.
I promise that your money
will be put to good use in
benefiting the poor and needy.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯]
非常感謝你捐出 {0} Zeny。我保證，這筆錢會妥善用於幫助貧困和有需要的人。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Still, I'm just a little
disappointed. An adventurer
like you should be donating
as much as you possibly can...
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯]
不過，我還是有點失望。像你這樣的冒險者，應該儘自己的能力多捐一些...

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
So far, I've received
a total of {0} zeny in
donations. I'm glad to see
that there are still kind and
generous people in the world.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯]
到目前為止，我總共收到了 {0} Zeny 的捐款。看到世上還有這麼多善良慷慨的人，我真高興。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
This should be enough
to send to the Poor Relief
Organization. Please accept
this small gift as a token of
my gratitude, adventurer. Bless
you, youngster and take care.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯]
這些錢應該夠送交貧困救濟組織了。冒險者，請收下這份小禮物，作為我的謝意。
願你平安，年輕人，保重。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
I understand. Still,
keep in mind that when
you give from your heart,
you will be rewarded tenfold.
Though I admit, the benefits
aren't always readily apparent.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯]
我明白。不過，請記住，發自內心地付出，會得到十倍的回報。
當然，我承認，這份回報未必馬上就看得見。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Hello youngster~
You seem to be fairly
well-off. Money is good
to have, but be careful not
to become obsessed with it.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯]
你好，年輕人~你看起來頗為富裕。
有錢是好事，可別太執著於錢財。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
When you have the chance,
please show your generosity
towards others who may be
much less fortunate than you.
scripts.translation:
[盧修斯]
有機會的話，請慷慨地幫助那些境遇遠不如你的人。

scripts.text:
[Laqumet]
Sure, manliness is quite
attractive, but I think women
appreciate a guy who could
sympathize and talk with them
a little more. Don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[拉庫梅特]
男子氣概是很有吸引力。不過，我覺得女人更喜歡能體諒她們、願意多陪她們聊聊的男人。
你說呢？

scripts.text:
[Laqumet]
I might not be like Sefith,
but I guess I've got a cute
smile, a good personality and
I'm a dandy to boot. Hopefully,
my honesty and loyalty will
help me find someone good.
scripts.translation:
[拉庫梅特]
我可能不像塞菲斯那麼出眾，不過，我笑起來挺可愛，性格也好，還很會打扮。
希望我的真誠和忠心，能幫我找到合適的人。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
If you are experiencing
any sort of inconvenience,
please do not hesitate and
let us know right away.
scripts.translation:
[酒店員工]
如果您遇到任何不便，請隨時告訴我們。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Please use the stairs
at the northern end to
go downstairs so that you
can go to the Front Desk.
Thank you and I hope that
you enjoy your stay here.
scripts.translation:
[酒店員工]
請從北側的樓梯下樓，前往前臺。
謝謝，祝您入住愉快。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Michael]
OoooOoh~
Soooo comfortable.
Don't want to wake up.
Don't want to get up.
Ever again. OoOoooh...
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·邁克爾]
哦哦哦~真舒服。
不想醒來，不想起床，再也不想。
哦哦哦...

scripts.text:
[Safwat Fahmy]
This hotel is nice
and comfortable, but
to be quite frank, the
drinks here are horrible.
They're unfit for drinking
men such as myself.
scripts.translation:
[薩夫瓦特·法赫米]
這家酒店不錯，住著也舒服。不過，老實說，這裡的酒實在難喝。
像我這樣的酒客，可喝不慣。

scripts.text:
[Safwat Fahmy]
If this is the best hotel,
I expect them to provide me
with the best alcohol. When
I stay at a hotel, that's what
I want. To spend the entire
day not being sober.
scripts.translation:
[薩夫瓦特·法赫米]
既然是最好的酒店，就該給我最好的酒。住酒店，我圖的就是這個：一整天都醉著，別醒過來。

scripts.text:
[Safwat Fahmy]
It looks like that
today I'll be heading
out to the bar again...
I just wish there were
someplace quieter to drink.
scripts.translation:
[薩夫瓦特·法赫米]
看來今天我又得去酒吧了...
我真希望能有個更安靜的地方喝酒。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
This is the Couple Suite.
A single can also check
in here, but our hotel will
prioritize couples when
assigning this room.
scripts.translation:
[酒店員工]
這裡是情侶套房。單人也可以入住，不過，安排這間房時，我們會優先考慮情侶。

scripts.text:
[Tanoue]
This chair looks
very nice, but it really
chills my bottom. Brr...!
It's a might uncomfortable!
scripts.translation:
[田上]
這椅子看著挺漂亮，可坐著真冰屁股。嘶...！怪不舒服的！

scripts.text:
[Tanoue]
You know what the
perfect chair would
be like? It would be
plush and have electronic
massage and heating controls...
scripts.translation:
[田上]
你知道最理想的椅子該是什麼樣嗎？要軟軟的，還得能調節電動按摩和加熱功能...

scripts.text:
[Ben Allen]
Aaahhh Oooooh~
It's sooooo comfy~
The air's so fresh and
this couch is so plush...
Why can't home be like this?
scripts.translation:
[本·艾倫]
啊啊，哦哦~真舒服~
空氣清新，沙發又這麼軟...家裡怎麼就不能這樣呢？

scripts.text:
[Ben Allen]
I've been in those other
hotels and let me tell you,
this place is the best ever.
After a night's sleep over
here, I feel like a new man!
scripts.translation:
[本·艾倫]
別的酒店我也住過，我跟你說，這裡絕對是最好的。在這兒睡上一晚，整個人都像重新活過來了！

scripts.text:
[Harp]
Oh sweet jiminy...
That Kafra Lady is so hot.
What a body. And those glasses.
I just gotta ask her out somehow.
scripts.translation:
[豎琴]
天哪...那位卡普拉小姐真性感。那身材，還有那副眼鏡。
我一定得想辦法約她出來。

scripts.text:
[Harp]
Hm, but what should
I do? A love letter? Naw,
that's kind of outdated.
Argh, I can't think! Just
looking at her makes me feel
so happy! Praise be to Kafra!
scripts.translation:
[豎琴]
嗯，該怎麼做呢？寫情書？不，那有點過時了。
啊，想不出來！光是看著她就好幸福！讚美卡普拉！

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
''Hospitality with a smile
and total devotion to your
comfort.'' That's our motto
in the Royal Dragon Hotel.
Please inquire at the front
desk if you wish to check in.
scripts.translation:
[酒店員工]
“微笑待客，全心為您營造舒適體驗。”這是皇家龍酒店的服務宗旨。
如需入住，請到前臺諮詢。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Welcome to the
Royal Dragon Hotel Bar.
How about a nice night
cap before going to bed?
scripts.translation:
[酒店員工]
歡迎光臨皇家龍酒店酒吧。睡前來杯小酒，怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
If you're looking
for a friend, you
can almost always
make one in this bar.
Alcohol certainly is the
grease for social gears.
scripts.translation:
[酒店員工]
想交朋友的話，在這間酒吧幾乎總能交到。酒可真是社交的潤滑劑。

scripts.text:
[Hachi]
Oh yeah. I love-love-love
bars. If I don't come here
for the booze, then I'm here
for all these beautiful ladies.
scripts.translation:
[八]
沒錯，我最最最喜歡酒吧了。不為喝酒來，也是為這裡的美女們來。

scripts.text:
[Hachi]
Weird. It's the very first
time I've tried this place's
rum, but doesn't it taste like
pure sexiness to you? Huh...
Oh well, back to schmoozin'
with all the hot chicks~
scripts.translation:
[八]
真奇妙，我還是頭一次喝這裡的朗姆酒。你不覺得這味道簡直性感極了嗎？嗯...
算了，繼續找美女們搭訕去~

scripts.text:
[Duff]
Hey, you're from
Rune-Midgarts, right?
Please make yourself
at home while you're here
in Lighthalzen and have
yourself a good time.
scripts.translation:
[達夫]
嘿，你是從盧恩·米德加茲來的吧？在裡希塔樂鎮，就像在自己家一樣，盡情玩吧。

scripts.text:
[Rona]
I hate it when guys
just sidle up and sort
of just skip Steps One
and Two. And before you
get all weird, Step Three
is ''Ask for my phone number.''
scripts.translation:
[羅娜]
我最煩那些一湊過來，就跳過第一步和第二步的男人。
先別想歪，第三步只是“問我要電話號碼”。

scripts.text:
[Rona]
I would just really
appreciate it if one
nice boy would just
talk to me for real.
scripts.translation:
[羅娜]
只要有個好男孩能認認真真跟我聊聊，我就很開心了。

scripts.text:
[Greenfield]
I don't believe it...
This unlucky streak
will never end, will it?
I lost all my Apples
playing Dice today.
Again. Oh man...
scripts.translation:
[格林菲爾德]
真不敢相信...這倒霉運就沒完沒了嗎？今天玩骰子，又把所有蘋果都輸光了。
又是這樣。唉...

scripts.text:
[Greenfield]
Okay. Okay.
If I just keep
playing, eventually
I'll win. I mean, that's
the way the odds work, right?
Even when they're against me...
scripts.translation:
[格林菲爾德]
好吧，好吧。只要一直玩下去，總會贏的。
機率不就是這麼回事嗎？就算現在對我不利...

scripts.text:
[Terry]
I'm not big on drinking,
but the atmosphere in this
place is really nice. The
music they play is always
smooth and relaxing...
scripts.translation:
[特里]
我不怎麼愛喝酒，不過，這裡的氣氛真好。放的音樂總是輕柔舒緩，讓人放鬆...

scripts.text:
[Terry]
Yeah, this is a real cozy
joint. I recommend it to
all you tourists, actually.
Now why don't you kick
back and chill with me?
scripts.translation:
[特里]
是啊，這地方真舒服。我推薦所有遊客都來坐坐。
不如陪我一起歇會兒，放鬆一下？

scripts.text:
[Sei]
You see that guy?
That guy over there is
always looking at me.
I wonder... Does he want
to ask me out or something?
scripts.translation:
[聖]
你看到那個人了嗎？就是那邊那個，總在看我。
難道...他想約我出去？

scripts.text:
[Sei]
Well, if he does,
shouldn't he have
more guts? Or are 
you boys much more
shy than I think you are?
scripts.translation:
[聖]
要真是這樣，他不該大膽一點嗎？還是說，你們男孩子比我想的還害羞？

scripts.text:
[Sei]
Well, he is sort of
cute. Geez, this would
be so much easier if he
would just come up and
start talking to me...
scripts.translation:
[聖]
他倒是挺可愛的。唉，他要是直接過來找我說話，不就簡單多了...

scripts.text:
[Merpi]
Isn't the weather nice
today? All this sunlight
will dry these clothes
quickly and give them
a fresh, lovely scent.
scripts.translation:
[梅爾皮]
今天天氣真好，是吧？陽光這麼足，衣服很快就能曬乾，還會帶上一股清新的香味。

scripts.text:
[Merpi]
Oh, an adventurer from
Rune-Midgarts, are you?
How do you like our city?
If you have any questions,
feel free to ask me anything.
scripts.translation:
[梅爾皮]
哦，你是從盧恩·米德加茲來的冒險者吧？覺得我們這座城怎麼樣？
有什麼想知道的，儘管問我。

scripts.text: Well, I have nothing to ask...
scripts.translation: 嗯，我沒什麼要問的...

scripts.text: Any news or rumors?
scripts.translation: 有什麼新聞或傳聞嗎？

scripts.text: I like laundry too.
scripts.translation: 我也喜歡洗衣服

scripts.text:
[Merpi]
Oh, really?
Well, if you've traveled
all over the world, maybe
you've found a place just
like Lighthalzen, so maybe
you're already comfortable?
scripts.translation:
[梅爾皮]
哦，是嗎？你走遍了世界各地，也許到過跟裡希塔樂鎮差不多的地方，所以已經習慣這裡了？

scripts.text:
[Merpi]
Well, things have
been pretty peaceful
for the past few years.
The only rumor floating
around is about some
weird axe murderer...
scripts.translation:
[梅爾皮]
這幾年都挺太平的。外面流傳的，就只有那個奇怪的連環斧頭殺人犯的故事...

scripts.text:
[Merpi]
Oh, that's wonderful!
I so love doing hand
laundry, though I'm not
quite sure why. Oh well~
scripts.translation:
[梅爾皮]
哦，太好了！我特別喜歡親手洗衣服，雖然自己也不知道為什麼。
算啦~

scripts.text:
[Berru]
Daddy...! Waaaaah~!
I wanna see my Daddy!
scripts.translation:
[貝魯]
爸爸...！哇啊啊~！
我想見爸爸！

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
Berru, I don't 
think Daddy's coming
home tonight. Come on,
we should go to bed.
scripts.translation:
[皮莉婭]
貝魯，爸爸今晚可能不會回來了。來，我們該睡覺了。

scripts.text:
[Berru]
No, I'm not gonna
sleep till Daddy gets
home! He said he'll
bring us candy tonight!
You go sleep first, Pilia!
scripts.translation:
[貝魯]
不要！爸爸沒回家，我就不睡！他說今晚要給我們帶糖果的！
皮莉婭，你先去睡吧！

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Where's our Daddy?
He said he found a
good job, but we haven't
heard from him since then...
scripts.translation:
[皮莉婭]
^333333*唉...*^000000
爸爸在哪兒呢？他說找到了一份好工作，可從那以後，我們就再沒他的訊息了...

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
What's taking him
so long? I hope Daddy
comes back home soon.
Come on, Berru, don't cry.
scripts.translation:
[皮莉婭]
他怎麼這麼久還沒回來？
希望爸爸能快點回家。
別哭了，貝魯。

scripts.text:
[Berru]
^333333*Sob...*^000000
But I'm hungry
and I miss Daddy!

[Pilia]
Uncle Togii from
next door hasn't
come back either...
scripts.translation:
[皮莉婭]
隔壁的托吉叔叔也還沒回來...

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
Hmm? Oh, I'm sorry,
but my little brother
just won't stop crying.
I'm sorry if we're loud...
scripts.translation:
[皮莉婭]
嗯？哦，對不起，我弟弟一直哭個不停。要是吵到你了，真不好意思...

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
Our daddy goes to work
somewhere far away. He
finally has a good job, but
sometimes we don't hear
from him for days. We get
really worried about him.
scripts.translation:
[皮莉婭]
爸爸在很遠的地方工作。他好不容易找到一份好工作，可有時候一連好幾天都沒訊息。
我們真的很擔心他。

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
My brother Berru always
misses him a lot. I don't
know how to make him
stop crying! What do I do?
scripts.translation:
[皮莉婭]
我弟弟貝魯總是特別想爸爸。我都不知道怎麼哄他不哭了！該怎麼辦呢？

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Please...
My child is starving...
Would you give me
some money?
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
求求你...我的孩子快餓死了...能給我一點錢嗎？

scripts.text: Give him some money.
scripts.translation: 給他一些錢

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 無視他

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
I appreciate your
kindness, but it also
looks like you're in need
of zeny, too. Would you
like to join me?
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
謝謝你的好意，不過，看起來你自己也缺 Zeny。要不要和我一起乞討？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here you go,
take this.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
給你，拿著吧。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Thank you so much.
I have nothing to offer you
in exchange, but I can share
a story with you and impart
some of the wisdom I've
learned over the years.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
太感謝了。我沒什麼能回報你的，不過，可以給你講個故事，分享一些這些年悟出的道理。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Everyone's been in
a situation where you
sometimes you feel that
you have to make a choice
between doing the right thing
and doing what you want, right?
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
有時候，做正確的事和做自己想做的事，似乎只能選一個。這種情況，誰都遇到過，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
You may feel trapped.
Well, let me tell you, when
it comes to a problem, all
the solutions available to
you aren't always obvious.
So just calm down and think.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
你也許會覺得走投無路。不過，面對問題時，並不是所有解決辦法都能一眼看出來。
所以，先靜下心來，好好想想。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
What you can see and
understand might not match
with reality. Like the stars that are always there, but not visible
during the day, we'll always have hope, even if we can't see it.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
你所看到、所理解的，未必就是全部事實。就像星星一直都在，只是白天看不見。
希望也始終存在，即使我們看不到它。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Hmm...?
You seem surprised~
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
嗯...？你好像很驚訝~

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
I sort of believe in fate and
sort of don't. Let me explain
it this way. I take life day by
day, with each day covering its
own spectrum with miracle on one end and tragedy on the other.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
我有些相信命運，又有些不信。這麼說吧，我一天一天地過日子。
每一天都充滿可能，一端是奇蹟，另一端是悲劇。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
So each day has the capacity
for experiences that can be
good, bad or both. I believe
each person can take an 
active role in shaping their
destiny, day by day.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
所以，每天都可能遇到好事、壞事，也可能兩者都有。
我相信，每個人都能主動塑造自己的命運，一天一天地改變它。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Now, there may be certain
things that you can't control,
but even a pessimist might
be able to agree that this
is a world that not only has
tragedy, but miracles as well.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
當然，有些事不由你控制。不過，即使再悲觀的人也該承認，這世界不只有悲劇，也有奇蹟。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Stand up when you're down
and live your life with passion. The capacity for miracles will
always be there and know that
you can be someone else's
miracle. Isn't that wonderful?
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
跌倒了就站起來，滿懷熱情地生活。奇蹟始終有可能發生，你也可以成為別人生命中的奇蹟。
這不是很美好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Don't believe me?
Well, you'll see for
yourself, youngster.
There's much good in you.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
不信嗎？年輕人，你總會親眼看到的。你心裡有很多善意。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Anger. People deal with
it in different ways. Some
suppress it. Some relish it.
Some fear being angry. Now,
to be simple, let's say there
are two kinds of anger.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
說到憤怒，每個人應對的方式都不一樣。有人壓抑它，有人享受它，也有人害怕生氣。
簡單點說，我們把憤怒分成兩種。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
The first is the kind that
isn't so productive. More of
a frustration that you can let
go. Someone cut you off on the
freeway or a friend innocently forgot your birthday? No biggie.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
第一種沒什麼益處，更像是可以放下的煩躁。比如有人開車搶了你的道，或者朋友無意間忘了你的生日。
這些都沒什麼大不了的。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Don't let this kind of
anger get to you or you'll
look like a loser. Think of
the big picture and if you're
still upset, vent appropriately. Be honest without hurting anyone.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
別被這種怒氣左右，不然只會顯得很沒出息。把眼光放遠一點。
如果還是生氣，就用合適的方式宣洩。坦誠表達，但別傷害任何人。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
The second kind of anger
is righteous anger. You've
been wronged and need 
some form of retribution. 
Just don't misdirect your anger
and respond appropriately.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
第二種是義憤。你受了不公正的對待，需要討個公道。
但別遷怒於人，要用恰當的方式回應。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
The second kind of anger is
righteous anger. You've been
wronged and need some form
of retribution. Remember to
make appropriate confrontations
and don't misdirect your rage.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
第二種是義憤。你受了不公正的對待，需要討個公道。
記得用恰當的方式據理力爭，別把怒火發洩到無關的人身上。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Getting into a fight with
righteous anger, say to protect
someone dear to you, will make
you a hero. Fighting with anger
born of frustration will make you a bully. Know the difference.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
出於義憤而戰，比如為了保護你珍視的人，會讓你成為英雄。可只是因為不順心就動手，只會讓你成為惡霸。
要分清兩者的區別。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
What's wrong?
It might be a lot
to take in, I know.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
怎麼了？我知道，一下子講這麼多，可能不容易消化。

scripts.text:
[Reuben]
Someday...
Someday I just gotta
become a train conductor
and just get outta here!
I really hate this place!
scripts.translation:
[魯本]
總有一天...總有一天，我一定要當上列車長，離開這裡！
我真討厭這個地方！

scripts.text:
[Reuben]]
Wh-whoa...!
Did you just hear
me talk to myself?
Crud! Don't be so nosy!
scripts.translation:
[魯本]]
哇...哇！你聽見我剛才自言自語了？
該死！別多管閒事！

scripts.text:
[Reuben]
Hey. What are
you doing just
looking at me?
I don't know you
from Adam, so get lost~
scripts.translation:
[魯本]
喂，你盯著我幹嗎？我根本不認識你，走開~

scripts.text:
[Shengwen]
Am I just getting
paranoid? I really
think that some of
the people I know
are disappearing
for no good reason!
scripts.translation:
[聖文]
難道是我太多疑了？我真的覺得，有些認識的人，莫名其妙就消失了！

scripts.text:
[Shengwen]
I mean, all of my close
friends are all alright,
but I'm starting not to see
certain acquaintances and
familiar faces. Maybe I'm
just thinking too much...
scripts.translation:
[聖文]
我的好友們倒都沒事，可有些熟人、常見的面孔，最近都看不到了。
也許只是我想多了...

scripts.text:
[Shayna]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Oh, you poor
darling girl...

[Cenku Dekdam]
Man, if you were
gonna take this whole
city and then sell it, what
do you think Lighthalzen's
price tag would be, eh?
scripts.translation:
[岑庫·德克丹]
老兄，要是把整座裡希塔樂鎮拿來賣，你覺得能賣多少錢？

scripts.text:
[Cenku Dekdam]
I mean, this city
is basically just made
of money. Money is what
makes this city such a nice
and pleasant place to live.
scripts.translation:
[岑庫·德克丹]
這座城簡直就是用錢堆起來的。正是錢，才讓這裡的生活這麼美好舒適。

scripts.text:
[Angela]
Greetings, adventurer.
I'm Angela, a social
worker for the Poor
Relief Organization.
scripts.translation:
[安吉拉]
你好，冒險者。我叫安吉拉，是貧困救濟組織的社工。

scripts.text:
[Angela]
I've noticed that the
people living here have
extremely bad health and
it's not just because of
their circumstances.
scripts.translation:
[安吉拉]
我發現，這裡的居民健康狀況極差，而且不只是生活困苦造成的。

scripts.text:
[Angela]
I've filed a report
to my superiors, but
they haven't sent me
a response yet for some
reason. I'm starting to get
a little worried about this...
scripts.translation:
[安吉拉]
我已經向上級提交了報告，可不知為什麼，一直沒收到回覆。我開始有些擔心了...

scripts.text:
[Bankri Kun]
Must work...
Must focus...
Resist sleepiness...
Why do I keep coming
here? Ugh, h-horrible.
scripts.translation:
[班克里·昆]
得工作...得集中精神...不能睡著...
我怎麼老來這裡？唉，真...真糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Bankri Kun]
Hey youngster. You wanted
adventuring advice? Okay.
Um. Hm. Always. Brush.
Your teeth. Brush them
everyday. Oh, and don't
forget to floss, either.
scripts.translation:
[班克里·昆]
嘿，年輕人。你想聽點冒險建議？好吧。
呃，嗯。一定。要。刷牙。每天都要刷。
哦，也別忘了用牙線。

scripts.text:
[Bankri Kun]
Now it's time for me
to head back to work.
I'll see you later, kid.
Sorry my advice was so
lame-- I couldn't think of
anything else to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[班克里·昆]
該回去工作了。回頭見，小傢伙。
抱歉，建議太沒用了——我實在想不出還有什麼能告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
So, the novel I ordered from
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom
just recently arrived. It's real good, by the guy who wrote
''Roda Frog Adventure''
years ago. Remember?
scripts.translation:
[埃諾茲]
我從盧恩·米德加茲王國訂的小說，最近剛送到。寫得真不錯，作者就是幾年前寫《羅達蛙冒險》的那個人。
你還記得吧？

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
Anyway, this new book,
''Where the Red Plant Grows''
is up for the Yggdrasilberry
Award. I... I don't know why
I was compelled to share that
with you. Seriously, I don't...
scripts.translation:
[埃諾茲]
這本新書《紅草生長的地方》，正在角逐天地樹果實獎。
我...我也不知道為什麼非要把這事告訴你。真的，我不知道...

scripts.text:
[Ellette]
...

[{0}]
Excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello?

[Ellette]
...Oh! Everyone!
I just completed
another one! Hooray!
scripts.translation:
[艾萊特]
...哦！大家快看！我又完成一個了！萬歲！

scripts.text:
[All other Employees]
Wh-what?!
No way, not again!
scripts.translation:
[其他所有員工]
什...什麼？！不會吧，怎麼又完成了！

scripts.text:
[Leekal]
Are you even human?
You must have some
secret for that much
productivity. It's weird...
scripts.translation:
[利卡爾]
你真的是人嗎？效率這麼高，一定有什麼秘訣吧。太奇怪了...

scripts.text:
[Ellette]
Oh, come on.
Maybe I'm a little
good at this, but there's
no way I can beat Cenku.
scripts.translation:
[艾萊特]
哎呀，別這樣。也許我確實挺擅長這個，可怎麼也比不過岑庫。

scripts.text:
[Dowbow Ryuei]
Just out of, oh I dunno,
curiosity, which word do
you like better? ''Uber-Cool''
or ''Reality?'' Pick one~
scripts.translation:
[道寶 龍英]
只是出於，呃，怎麼說呢，好奇吧。你更喜歡哪個詞：“超酷”還是“現實”？選一個~

scripts.text: Uber-Cool
scripts.translation: 超酷

scripts.text: Reality
scripts.translation: 現實

scripts.text:
[Dowbow Ryuei]
Oh yeah? Me too!
Yeah, we got the same
outlook on life. If you don't
mind, I'd like to shake
your hand, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[道寶 龍英]
哦，是嗎？我也是！看來我們的人生觀一樣。
冒險者，不介意的話，握個手吧。

scripts.text:
[Dowbow Ryuei]
Reality, eh?
Well, I agree that
being realistic has its
perks, I'm more of a dreamer.
scripts.translation:
[道寶 龍英]
現實，是吧？我承認，務實有務實的好處，不過，我更像個夢想家。

scripts.text:
[Leekal]
So... Very broke.
Why did I spend so much
money on wine, women and
song? I regret it all, all the
pleasure I've had this month.
Yes, it was too much pleasure.
scripts.translation:
[利卡爾]
窮...窮死了。我幹嗎在吃喝玩樂上花那麼多錢？
這個月的享樂，現在全都後悔了。沒錯，玩得太過頭了。

scripts.text:
[Ninjose]
That's what happens
when you're irresponsible
with your money. You really
should read this ''Anybody
Can Be Rich'' book.
scripts.translation:
[寧霍塞]
這就是亂花錢的下場。你真該讀讀這本《人人都能致富》。

scripts.text:
[Ninjose]
At long last, I've finally
bought my own home. You
should invest your money for
your future too! Read this,
''Anybody Can Be Rich!''
It's such a great book!
scripts.translation:
[寧霍塞]
終於，我買下自己的房子了！你也該為未來投資！
讀讀這本《人人都能致富》吧，寫得太好了！

scripts.text:
[Kejulle Rekenber]
Hm? Sure, my last name
is Rekenber and that's the
same name as our chairman,
but that's just a coincidence.
I'm merely a normal employee.
Yeah, no special treatment...
scripts.translation:
[凱朱勒·雷肯貝爾]
嗯？我確實姓雷肯貝爾，跟我們董事長同姓，不過，只是巧合。
我就是個普通員工。沒錯，沒有特殊待遇...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis man here
is motionless,
and for all intents
and purposes, is
soundly asleep.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這個男人一動不動，怎麼看都像是睡得正香。^000000

scripts.text:
[Joshua]
What am I doing here?
Waiting for my dream
woman to fall into my lap,
what else does it look like?
scripts.translation:
[約書亞]
我在這兒幹嗎？當然是等夢中情人主動投懷送抱，還能幹嗎？

scripts.text:
[Joshua]
Tall, blond, creamy
complexion and smooth
skin. That's right. Come
right to Joshua, babes.
I got my pheromone spray
on and I'm ready to cruise~
scripts.translation:
[約書亞]
身材高挑，金髮，膚色白皙，肌膚光滑。沒錯，寶貝們，快來找約書亞吧。
我已經噴好費洛蒙噴霧，準備獵豔了~

scripts.text:
[Grinnel]
You know the men in
black suits? Boy, did
I get a scare! They actually
tracked me down to ask me
all these weird questions!
scripts.translation:
[格林內爾]
你知道那些穿黑西裝的人嗎？真把我嚇壞了！他們竟然專門找上我，問了一堆古怪的問題！

scripts.text:
[Grinnel]
They kept wanting to
know if I had ever met
anyone from the Rekenber
Corporation, if I've ever been
Uptown, that sort of thing. They
really scared the crap out of me.
scripts.translation:
[格林內爾]
他們一直追問我是否見過雷肯貝爾公司的人，是否去過上城區之類的問題。他們真的把我嚇壞了。

scripts.text:
[Grinnel]
Man, living in the
slums is such a drag.
Not only is life rough,
but all sorts of people
think they can push you
around. I hate Lighthalzen...
scripts.translation:
[格林內爾]
住在貧民窟真難熬。日子已經夠苦了，什麼人還都覺得能隨便欺負你。
我討厭裡希塔樂鎮...

scripts.text:
[Haggar]
Whiskey!
I need me some
hard liquor now!
scripts.translation:
[哈加爾]
威士忌！我現在就要喝烈酒！

scripts.text:
[Haggar]
Wha--? I didn't
order this stinkin'
rum! I want a man's
drink! Gimme whiskey!
scripts.translation:
[哈加爾]
什...什麼？我可沒點這破朗姆酒！我要喝男人該喝的酒！給我威士忌！

scripts.text:
[Tony]
Hey man, I know this
joint is a dive, pretty much
on the verge of bein' totally
ghetto, but we're proud to
have the best rum in all of
Midgard. It's true~
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
嘿，夥計，我知道這裡破破爛爛，快跟貧民窟一樣了。可我們有全米德加爾特最好的朗姆酒，這就是我們的驕傲。
千真萬確~

scripts.text:
[Tony]
Hey lady, I know this
joint is a dive, pretty much
on the verge of bein' totally
ghetto, but we're proud to
have the best rum in all of
Midgard. It's true~
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
嘿，女士，我知道這裡破破爛爛，快跟貧民窟一樣了。可我們有全米德加爾特最好的朗姆酒，這就是我們的驕傲。
千真萬確~

scripts.text:
[Tony]
Just a sip of this
beautiful drink and
you're on top of the
world! But it's best
for helpin' yah relax
and forget your worries.
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
這美酒只要抿上一口，就能讓你樂上天！不過，它最擅長的還是讓人放鬆，忘掉煩惱。

scripts.text:
[Tony]
I don't take to bein'
a poet, but I do know
this. Our rum has the
sweet sweet flavor of
loneliness. You really
oughta try it when you can.
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
我不是什麼詩人，可我知道，我們的朗姆酒裡有孤獨的甜美滋味。
有機會一定要嚐嚐。

scripts.text:
[Garry]
Hey! Hey you...!
D'you wanna, you
wanna hear me tell
you a joke?! It goes...
Um, it goes like this...
scripts.translation:
[加里]
嘿！喂，你...！你想不想，想不想聽我講個笑話？！是這麼說的...
呃，是這麼說的...

scripts.text:
[Garry]
Hey riddle middle,
the cat and th--
No! No, damn it!
That's a song!
No, wait, that's
not a song either...
scripts.translation:
[加里]
嘿，謎語叮噹，貓和那——
不！不對，該死！那是首歌！
不，等等，那也不是歌...

scripts.text:
[Bonse]
*Hiccup* I loooove
this rum! I caught a cold
once and one glass made
it go away! 'Course, I slept
for a week too, but that don't
matter! Pshaw! Science...
scripts.translation:
[邦塞]
*嗝* 我太——愛這朗姆酒了！有一回我感冒，喝一杯就好了！
當然，我也睡了整整一星期，可那不重要！哼！什麼科學...

scripts.text:
[Bonse]
Oh, the flavor is just
so clean, but it's also
got a bit of a kick. I don't
know how to describe it.
Its the taste of happiness?
I'm too drunk to even tell!
scripts.translation:
[邦塞]
哦，這味道真清爽，可後勁也不小。不知道該怎麼形容。
是幸福的滋味？醉成這樣，我也說不清了！

scripts.text:
[Assam]
This place is nice
and usually pretty quiet.
I like to come here after
work, have a drink and just
chat with the bartender.
scripts.translation:
[阿薩姆]
這裡挺好，平時也安靜。我喜歡下班後來喝一杯，跟調酒師聊聊天。

scripts.text:
[Assam]
The rum here is incredibly
good too. It might even be
the best in the world. I dunno
why, but for some reason, its
taste reminds me of teamwork~
scripts.translation:
[阿薩姆]
這裡的朗姆酒也特別好喝，也許是世界上最好的。
不知為什麼，這味道總讓我想起團隊合作~

scripts.text:
[Lanko]
Oh, I'm only here
working as a waitress
to help out my father.
This job is so tiring, but
it's nice to see people so
relaxed and having a good time.
scripts.translation:
[蘭科]
哦，我在這裡當服務員，只是為了幫爸爸的忙。工作是挺累，不過，看見大家放鬆下來，玩得開心，也挺好的。

scripts.text:
[Lanko]
When I get some time
off, I'm going to explore
Lighthalzen and see all that
there is to see. But for now,
it doesn't look like we've got
any real shortage of drunks...
scripts.translation:
[蘭科]
等有空了，我要好好逛逛裡希塔樂鎮，把能看的都看一遍。
可眼下，我們這裡的醉鬼似乎一點也不缺...

scripts.text:
[Enku]
*Sob* I just got
dumped! Yeah, I thought
we were gonna get married,
but obviously I was wrong!
Damn it Sheryline! I loved you!
scripts.translation:
[恩庫]
*嗚嗚* 我剛被甩了！我還以為我們會結婚，顯然是我想錯了！
該死，雪琳！我那麼愛你！

scripts.text:
[Enku]
I usually don't care for
drinking, especially stuff
like gin or rum, but today,
this stuff tastes just like
my misery. This is all the
comfort I need, you hear?!
scripts.translation:
[恩庫]
我平時不愛喝酒，尤其是金酒、朗姆酒這種。可今天，這酒的味道就像我的痛苦。
我只需要這種安慰，聽見沒有？！

scripts.text:
[Linus]
After ten years
of marriage. My
wife divorced me...
scripts.translation:
[萊納斯]
結婚十年，我妻子跟我離婚了...

scripts.text:
[Linus]
So I guess there's no
place for me but here for
now. I don't know what it is,
but the rum is really good
today. Like, it's the flavor
of relaxing, joyous relief~
scripts.translation:
[萊納斯]
看來，眼下除了這兒，我也沒別的地方可去了。
不知怎麼回事，今天的朗姆酒特別好喝。就像輕鬆、快樂、如釋重負的滋味~

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
You know, everyone
is different, but I think
humans are similar enough
that we can all meaningfully
connect on some level, right?
scripts.translation:
[米切爾]
你知道嗎，雖然每個人都不一樣，但我認為人類在本質上足夠相似，我們總能在某個層面上產生共鳴，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Sure, a rich person might
have different problems than
a poor person, but the point
is, they've both got problems!
Pain, pleasure, sadness, joy.
Those link us all together.
scripts.translation:
[米切爾]
沒錯，富人和窮人的煩惱可能不同，但重點是，他們都有煩惱！痛苦、快樂、悲傷、喜悅，這些情感將我們聯絡在一起。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
So try not to be picky
about who's your pal and
who's not. We all need
somebody to be with, right?
scripts.translation:
[米切爾]
所以，交朋友別太挑剔。我們都需要有人陪伴，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Dique]
One of the things I look
forward to during my day
is the drink I enjoy right
after work. It's the most
relaxing thing in the world.
scripts.translation:
[迪克]
我每天最期待的事之一，就是下班後喝上一杯。那真是世上最讓人放鬆的享受。

scripts.text:
[Dique]
Of course, there's
more to life than just
hanging out in pubs and
bars. The thing is, in my
case, pubs and bars are
all I happen to need~
scripts.translation:
[迪克]
當然，生活不僅僅是泡在酒吧裡。不過對我來說，酒吧就是我需要的一切~

scripts.text:
[Loudmouth]
Do you know who I am?!
Just look at this peg leg.
I was in the Comodo War,
Ski Troop division! I lost my
leg to earn your freedom!
scripts.translation:
[大嘴巴]
你知道我是誰嗎？！看看這條假腿。我參加過克魔島戰爭，是滑雪部隊的！我為了你們的自由失去了這條腿！

scripts.text:
[Loudmouth]
H-hey! What's that
look for? What, you
don't believe me?!
scripts.translation:
[大嘴巴]
喂...喂！你那是什麼眼神？怎麼，不信我？！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
This is a
restricted area.
Please keep clear
if you do not have
special authorization.
Thank you for your cooperating.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
這裡是管制區域，沒有特別許可，請勿靠近。
感謝您的配合。

scripts.text:
[Lasoei]
Oh phooey.
The same customers
are always coming in,
day after day. Can it
get any less exciting?
scripts.translation:
[拉索埃]
唉，天天來的都是那幾個老顧客。真是無聊透了。

scripts.text:
[Lasoei]
Oh...!
W-welcome~
C-can I help you
with anything?
scripts.translation:
[拉索埃]
哦...！
歡...歡迎~
需...需要我為您做些什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Geonuii]
Greetings. This path
leads to the Library and
the Laboratory. Please be
aware that these places
are restricted from access
by the general public.
scripts.translation:
[格奴伊]
您好，這條路通往圖書館和實驗室。請注意，這兩個地方都不對公眾開放。

scripts.text:
[Bonnie]
Oh no...
Where did I put it?
scripts.translation:
[邦妮]
糟糕...
我把它放哪兒了？

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
^3355FF(Whoa, it's a member
of the staff!)^000000 Good day!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵]
^3355FF（哇，是職員！）^000000 您好！

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
This is a restricted
area! Please show
some ID immediately!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵]
這裡是限制區域！請立即出示證件！

scripts.text: ID?
scripts.translation: 證件？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
I don't know how you
adventurers do things in
Rune-Midgarts, but over here
we have laws about trespassing!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵]
我不知道你們冒險者在盧恩·米德加茲是怎麼辦事的，可我們這裡擅闖禁區是違法的！

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Unless you have special
authorization, nobody is
allowed into the Underground
Laboratory for security reasons.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵]
為了安全起見，沒有特別許可，任何人都不得進入地下實驗室。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Keep your eyes open.
I've heard rumors that some
adventurers from Rune-Midgarts
are trying to sneak into here!
I know the security here is
pretty much fail sure, but...
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵]
盯緊點！聽說有些盧恩·米德加茲來的冒險者想偷偷潛入這裡！
我知道這裡的安保幾乎萬無一失，可是...

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
This area is restricted
to the public! Who are you
and how did you get in here?!
Hey, I need backup right away!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵]
這裡不對公眾開放！你是誰，怎麼進來的？！
喂，馬上派人來支援！

scripts.text:
[Repairman]
No wonder these things
break all the time! These
machines have been totally
abused! Ugh, there's no
appreciation for all of this
convenient technology...
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
難怪這些東西老壞！機器都被糟蹋成這樣了！
唉，這些技術讓人這麼方便，怎麼就沒人珍惜呢...

scripts.text:
[Repairman]
Yeah, all of this lab
equipment is really sensitive,
not to mention expensive. If
you ever handle this stuff, you
need to be extra cautious.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
沒錯，這些實驗室裝置都非常精密，而且價格昂貴。如果你要操作這些裝置，必須格外小心。

scripts.text:
[Repairman]
Hey, you don't work--
G-guards! Hurry! There's
somebody over here!
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
嘿，你不在這裡工作——
衛...衛兵！快過來！這裡有人！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Alright. Pull one test
tube out of the machine,
replace the other test
tube over here and then
clean the first test tube?
scripts.translation:
[科學家]
好，先從機器裡取出一支試管，把這邊另一支換上，然後清洗第一支試管？

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Or do I clean the test tube,
put it into the machine and
then replace the other one?
I'm so confused with this
procedure! If only I didn't
lose the instructions...
scripts.translation:
[科學家]
還是先洗試管，再放進機器，然後換另一支？
這流程真把我搞糊塗了！要是沒弄丟說明書就好了...

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Alright. Pull one test
tube out of the machine,
replace th--hey. You're
not Ralphie. Wait. Guaaards!
Help me, there's some weirdo!
scripts.translation:
[科學家]
好，先從機器裡取出一支試管，再換——嘿，你不是拉爾菲。
等等！衛兵——！快來幫我，這兒有個怪人！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Whoa whoa~!
Please! Don't
touch anything!
I'm dealing with highly
volatile chemicals here!
scripts.translation:
[科學家]
喂喂~！拜託，什麼都別碰！我正在處理極易揮發的化學品！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Guards! Hurry,
there's someone
here, and I think
it's one of those crazy
stalkers! Why, why me?!
scripts.translation:
[科學家]
衛兵！快來，這裡有人，我看是個瘋狂的跟蹤狂！
為什麼，為什麼偏偏找上我？！

scripts.text: Nice day, huh?
scripts.translation: 天氣不錯，是吧？

scripts.translation: 取消

[Regenschirm Guard]
Do you wish to
go underground?
scripts.translation:
[雷根席爾姆衛兵]
您要去地下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Regenschirm Guard]
May I help you?
If you would like to
enter, you must first
have a Laboratory Permit.
Thank you for your cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[雷根席爾姆衛兵]
有什麼可以幫您？如需進入，請先出示研究所進出卡片。
感謝您的配合。

scripts.text: Yes

scripts.text: No

Thank you and
have a nice day.
scripts.translation:

謝謝，祝您一天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Regenschirm Guard]
Thank you and
have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[雷根席爾姆衛兵]
謝謝，祝您一天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Arthur]
The chairs here are
so not ergonomic. And
they're uncomfortable too!
But it's sooo cool inside this
bank and I just wanted to get
get away from all this heat...
scripts.translation:
[亞瑟]
這裡的椅子一點也不符合人體工學，坐著還不舒服！
可銀行裡真涼快，我只是想躲躲外面的熱氣...

scripts.text:
[Helen]
You know, maybe when
I grow up, I'll be a bank
clerk. That sounds like a
really nice job, don't you
think? It's laid back and posh...
scripts.translation:
[海倫]
你知道嗎，也許等我長大了，我會成為一名銀行職員。聽起來是一份很棒的工作，你覺得呢？工作輕鬆又體面...

scripts.text:
[Tadem]
I do so enjoy the
architectural structure
of this bank. It's quite
artistic with both classical
and modern elements. Would
you not agree? Fascinating...
scripts.translation:
[塔德姆]
我非常欣賞這家銀行的建築結構。它兼具古典與現代元素，頗具藝術感。您不覺得嗎？真是迷人...

scripts.text:
[Gracie]
Oh, it's so comfortable
in here~ Though, why are
we inside the bank when
the bank services aren't even
working? Yes, we're standing,
but we're doing it in comfort.
scripts.translation:
[格蕾西]
哦，這裡真舒服~可是，銀行業務都暫停了，我們幹嗎還待在裡面呢？
沒錯，我們是站著，可站得也很舒服呀。

scripts.text:
[Gracie]
In fact, it's so
comfortable here,
I think I'll refuse to leave.
Though, I'm willing to change
my mind if you can find a place
that's even more comfortable.
scripts.translation:
[格蕾西]
這裡實在太舒服了，我都不想走。不過，要是你能找到更舒服的地方，我倒願意改主意。

scripts.text:
[Bank Clerk]
Due to some critical system
errors, all of the bank services
have been temporarily stopped.
We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.
scripts.translation:
[銀行職員]
由於系統出現嚴重故障，銀行所有業務暫時停止。
給您帶來不便，我們深表歉意，感謝您的理解。

scripts.text:
[Togii]
Oooh yeah...
Goes down smooth.
Morocc whiskey's the best!
^333333*Hiccup*^000000 Whoa, this stuff
really works fast! Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[托吉]
哦，真不錯...入喉順滑。莫洛克的威士忌最棒了！
^333333*嗝*^000000 哇，這酒勁來得真快！嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Healthy Looking Guy]
Grrrrrr! Leave me alone!
How many times do I have
to keep telling you? I've never
hoarded item upgrade materials!
I swear that I'm innocent!
scripts.translation:
[看起來很健康的傢伙]
可惡！別煩我了！到底還要說多少遍？我從沒囤積過裝備精煉材料！
我發誓，我是清白的！

scripts.text:
[Hinkley]
Meh heh heh...
^333333*Hiccup*^000000 Believe
it or notsh, I'm...
walkin on a... Air...
Nevah thought I could
b-be sho freee-eeee-eee~
scripts.translation:
[欣克利]
嘿嘿嘿...
^333333*嗝*^000000 信不信由你，我...正踩著...空氣...走呢...
沒想到能這...這麼自——由——呀~

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis guy
is completely
hammered out
of his mind!^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這傢伙已經醉得神志不清了！^000000

scripts.text:
[Millette]
Let me go!
Let me GO!!
LET ME GO!!!
I didn't do nuthin'
wrong! I'm innocent!
^333333*Hic-Hic-Hiccup...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[米萊特]
放開我！
放開我啊！！
放開我！！！
我沒做錯任何事！我是清白的！
^333333*嗝-嗝-嗝...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Millette]
What's wrong with
drinking and singing
in the street, huh?
Is it a crime to have
a beautiful tenor voice?!
Get me outta this joint!
scripts.translation:
[米萊特]
在街上喝酒唱歌有什麼不對嗎？
擁有優美的男高音嗓音也是犯罪嗎？！
快把我從這鬼地方放出去！

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
Tell me...!
TELL ME...!!
Admit you did it!!
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
說...！快說...！！承認是你乾的！！

scripts.text:
[Suspect]
Damn it!
I keep telling
you I'm not guilty!
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
該死！說了多少遍，我沒罪！

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000

[Suspect]
You're wasting your
time. Just let me go.
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
你這是白費工夫。放我走吧。

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
So...
How's your mother?
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
那麼...你母親還好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Suspect]
That's none of
your business!
She's fine, I guess.
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
這不關你的事！
她應該沒事吧。

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
When was the last
time you've seen her?
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
你最後一次見到她是什麼時候？

scripts.text:
[Suspect]
I just told you,
that's none of
your business...!
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
剛才都說了，不關你的事...！

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
You know, mothers
throughout the animal
kingdom instinctively
care for their young.
Humans are no exception.
Yours must be worried to death.
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
動物的母親都會本能地照顧自己的孩子，人類也不例外。
你母親一定擔心壞了。

scripts.text:
[Suspect]
...
Man...
You're starting
to weird me out.
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
...
老兄...你說得我心裡直發毛。

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
Funny thing about humans,
though. It seems to be their
nature to lie, even when they
know they'll be caught. But
like all animals, they
instinctively fear pain...
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
不過，人類也挺有意思。明知會被揭穿，還是要撒謊，彷彿這是天性。
可他們跟所有動物一樣，本能地害怕疼痛...

scripts.text:
[Suspect]
N-no, no...
You gotta be...
You're bluffing.
Right?
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
不...不...你肯定是...
你在嚇唬我，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
NO.
You're bluffing.
Tell me...!
TELL ME...!!
Admit you did it!!
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
不，是你在虛張聲勢。
說...！快說...！！承認是你乾的！！

scripts.text:
[Banquet Staff]
This Banquet Hall is used
to hold events such as dinner
parties with partners, clients
and other associates, and press
conferences. Of course, there's
nothing going on right now.
scripts.translation:
[宴會工作人員]
這個宴會廳用來舉辦招待合作伙伴、客戶等賓客的晚宴，也會舉辦新聞釋出會。
當然，現在沒有活動。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Staff]
Sometimes peace and quiet
is a welcome change of pace,
but right now I'm feeling quite
bored. I think I would rather
be busy than twiddling my
thumbs, to tell the truth.
scripts.translation:
[宴會工作人員]
偶爾清靜一下，確實不錯。可眼下我實在無聊。
說真的，比起閒得無所事事，我寧願忙一點。

scripts.text:
[Luccet]
Shhhh! Hey, my brother's
''it,'' so I gotta find a place
to hide! Wait, would you just
stand really still? I could
just hide behind you! No?
Nuts! Olly olly oxen free!
scripts.translation:
[盧塞特]
噓！哥哥在找人，我得找個地方躲起來！
等等，你能站著別動嗎？我躲在你身後就行！不行？
討厭！不玩啦，大家都出來吧！

scripts.text:
[Hanccet]
Man... I hate being ''it!''
I'm horrible at this game!
Alright, okay, if I were my
sister Luccet, where would
I think I would not look for
me? Of course...! The sewers!
scripts.translation:
[漢塞特]
唉...我最討厭當找人的那個！這遊戲我玩得太差了！
好，想想，要是我是妹妹盧塞特，會躲在哪個我想不到的地方呢？
當然是...下水道！

scripts.text:
[Annette]
I've heard that the
Rekenber Banquet Hall
is also used to hold weddings.
That must be so wonderful~
scripts.translation:
[安妮特]
聽說雷肯貝爾宴會廳也會舉辦婚禮，一定很美好吧~

scripts.text:
[Annette]
Even if it is more expensive,
I'd want to have my wedding
here. Marriage is only once
in a lifetime, ideally, so I'd
want to make mine the most
memorable experience.
scripts.translation:
[安妮特]
就算貴一點，我也想在這裡辦婚禮。理想的話，人一輩子只結一次婚嘛。
所以，我希望自己的婚禮能成為最難忘的回憶。

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Shhhhhhzzzz*
*Shhhhhhzzzz*^000000

[Mereth]
Shhhhh....
Aaaaaaaahhh...
scripts.translation:
[梅雷斯]
噓...
啊哈...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe employee turned his
head and peered into your
eyes through the black mask
on his face. Mereth stared
wordlessly for a moment and
then began to dance a lively,
creepily jovial jig.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF那名職員轉過頭，透過臉上的黑色面具盯著你的雙眼。梅雷斯默默看了你片刻，隨後跳起一支歡快的小舞，歡快得有些詭異。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is simply a pile
of files, a smattering of
books and a family portrait.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡只是一堆檔案、幾本書和一幅全家福。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis desk is very
neat and well organized
in comparison to the other
desks you've seen in your
time. You take a moment to
fully marvel at its tidiness.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF比起你見過的其他辦公桌，這張桌子格外整潔，擺放井然有序。你不禁駐足片刻，讚歎它的整齊。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis desk has a bookshelf
that is crammed with all sorts
of books. Out of curiosity, you
decide to pick one out.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這張桌子配有一個書架，塞滿了各種書籍。出於好奇，你決定抽出一本看看。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFHowever, the book you
happen to touch contains
an amazing amount of dark
power, causing you to drop it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF然而，你碰到的那本書蘊含著驚人的黑暗力量，令你失手將它掉了下去。^000000

scripts.text:
[Noama]
Hee hee~!
You wanna hear
something funny?
I heard there's a bar in
Prontera where this guy
sneaks singles into Jawa--
scripts.translation:
[諾阿瑪]
嘿嘿~！想聽件有趣的事嗎？
聽說普隆德拉有間酒吧，有個傢伙會偷偷把單身的人送進爪哇——

scripts.text:
[Mazwon]
Noama...!
These machines are
acting up again! Get
over here right now!
scripts.translation:
[馬茲翁]
諾阿瑪...！這些機器又出毛病了！馬上過來！

scripts.text:
[Noama]
What?!
Stop bugging me,
I didn't do anything!
scripts.translation:
[諾阿瑪]
什麼？！別煩我，我什麼也沒幹！

scripts.text:
[Mazwon]
Crap. Crap! Crap
crap crap crap crap!
These desk machines aren't
supposed to work like this!
scripts.translation:
[馬茲翁]
糟了，糟了！糟了糟了糟了糟了糟了！
這些桌上的機器不該這樣運轉啊！

scripts.text:
[Mazwon]
Noama...!
These machines are
acting up again! Get
over here right now!
scripts.translation:
[馬茲翁]
諾阿瑪...！這些機器又出毛病了！馬上過來！

scripts.text:
[Noama]
What?!
Stop bugging me,
I didn't do anything!
scripts.translation:
[諾阿瑪]
什麼？！別煩我，我什麼也沒幹！

scripts.text:
[Mareth]
Yoo hoo hoo~
Oh, how I love
love love chocolate!
scripts.translation:
[馬雷斯]
喲呵呵~哦，我最最最喜歡巧克力了！

scripts.text:
[Mareth]
Eat it up...
Or just melt it.
Slather it all over me.
Booyah. New life aspiration.
scripts.translation:
[馬雷斯]
把它吃光...或者乾脆化開，塗滿我全身。
太棒了，這就是我的新人生目標。

scripts.text:
[Eiya]
Jorje seems so cranky
recently. He's usually
more laid back than this.
Oh well, I hope that he
feels better.
scripts.translation:
[英也]
約爾赫最近似乎很煩躁。
他平時沒這麼急躁的。
算了，希望他能好起來。

scripts.text:
[Eiya]
Ooh, would you like
to look at my miniature
doll collection? I love
collecting cute dolls!
scripts.translation:
[英也]
哦，想看看我收藏的迷你娃娃嗎？我最喜歡收集可愛的娃娃了！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou found a blackboard
filled with scribbling. You
can only read some of the
messages that have been
quickly scrawled on it.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了一塊寫滿塗鴉的黑板。
你只能看清其中一些匆忙寫下的留言。^000000

[Rocky]
Woof woof!
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
汪汪！

scripts.text:
[Rocky]
Grrrrrrr...
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
嗚嗚嗚...

scripts.text:
[Jay]
My mommy and daddy
always come home late.
So I eat dinner alone.
All by myself. Everyday.
scripts.translation:
[傑伊]
爸爸媽媽總是很晚才回家。所以我都是一個人吃晚飯。
就我自己，每天都是。

scripts.text:
[Jay]
Food doesn't taste as
good when you're not
eating with anybody.
Maybe I'm just lonely.
scripts.translation:
[傑伊]
一個人吃飯，食物好像沒那麼好吃了。
也許...我只是有點孤單。

scripts.text:
[Housemaid Jane]
This house is enormous...
It's clearly much too big
for a regularly sized family.
And it takes me forever to
make sure that it stays clean!
scripts.translation:
[女僕 簡]
這房子真大...普通一家人住，明顯太大了。光是把它保持乾淨，就得花我好多時間！

scripts.text:
[Housemaid Jane]
It's not easy keeping
things neat and tidy when
you're responsible for acres
of indoor living space. Being
a maid can be pretty hard...
scripts.translation:
[女僕 簡]
這麼大片室內空間，全歸我打理，想保持整潔可不容易。做女僕真辛苦...

scripts.text:
[Housemaid Brenda]
I better dust extra
gently around this vase.
It's worth ten million zeny
and if it were to-- No. No!
I'm not even going to think it!
scripts.translation:
[女僕 布倫達]
給這花瓶撣灰，可得格外輕手輕腳。它值一千萬 Zeny，要是——
不，不行！我連想都不敢想！

scripts.text:
[Benatuth]
Down there, the repairman
is just finishing maintenance
on our chairman's private
Airship. Can you imagine
having one of those of your
very own to fly around in?
scripts.translation:
[貝納圖斯]
下面的修理工，正快要給董事長的私人飛空艇做完保養。
你能想像擁有一艘自己的飛空艇，想飛哪兒就飛哪兒嗎？

scripts.text:
[Benatuth]
Yeah, the chairman of
the Rekenber Corporation...
He's a really powerful person.
It's almost scary what he can
do with his money, you know?
scripts.translation:
[貝納圖斯]
沒錯，就是雷肯貝爾公司的董事長...他可是個有權有勢的人。
有那麼多錢，他能做的事簡直讓人害怕，你明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Drew]
Dude, check it out~
Official glossy photos
of the Kafra Ladies. Now...
With 20% more garter belts!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵 德魯]
哥們，快看~卡普拉小姐們的官方亮面寫真。
現在...吊襪帶多了 20%！

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Tan]
So they're all wearing
garter belts in these?
Whoa, that means they
even got the glasses chick
to wear 'em too? That's the
best news I've heard all day!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵 譚]
所以，這裡面她們全都穿著吊襪帶？哇，連戴眼鏡的那個也穿了？
這可是我今天聽到的最好訊息！

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Drew]
Okay man, you know these
are limited edition collector's
items, so each one is worth
300,000 zeny. I mean, I have
an extra set, but I don't know
if you'd wanna buy them off--
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵 德魯]
老兄，你知道這些是限量收藏品，每張都值 300,000 Zeny。
我倒是多了一套，不過，不知道你想不想買——

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Tan]
I'll take them all.
Wait, all of them except
for that young kid. Just the
idea of having her glamour
photo around strikes me as...
Yeah. Yeah, it's no good.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵 譚]
我全要了。等等，那個小女孩的不要。
光是想到收藏她的寫真，就覺得...嗯，嗯，這不合適。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Tan]
Whoa, whoa. Now this...
This is art. The lighting,
the angle, the... the...
subject matter. Oh yes.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵 譚]
哇，哇。這個...這才叫藝術。光線，角度，還有...還有...拍攝物件。
哦，沒錯。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Drew]
Man, these officially licensed
Kafra Lady glossies... They're
worth every zeny we paid. Say
goodbye Swimsuit Calendar,
and hellooooo Kafra Leilah~
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵 德魯]
老兄，這些官方授權的卡普拉小姐亮面寫真，花的每一分 Zeny 都值！
再見，泳裝日曆。你好——卡普拉萊拉~

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Tan]
Leilah? Oh, you mean
the glasses chick? Dude...
Dude. She's my favorite too!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵 譚]
萊拉？哦，就是戴眼鏡的那個？老兄...老兄，我也最喜歡她！

scripts.text:
[Delna]
Sometimes the simple
pleasures can give you
the most happiness. For me,
going outside and basking in
the sun is the greatest thing~
scripts.translation:
[黛爾娜]
有時候，最簡單的樂趣反而最讓人幸福。對我來說，出門曬曬太陽，就是最棒的享受~

scripts.text:
[Delna]
Yes, sunbathing in a quiet
and relaxing place can be
so refreshing. And if you're
careful about not getting a
sunburn or a tan, a little sun
can be really good for you.
scripts.translation:
[黛爾娜]
是啊，找個安靜舒適的地方曬太陽，真讓人神清氣爽。
只要留意別曬傷、曬黑，適當曬一點，對身體很有好處。

scripts.text:
[Martial Artist]
Curses...
I've come to the
wrong place to seek
out a challenge. No
one here is really all
that mighty or competitive!
scripts.translation:
[武術家]
該死...想找人挑戰，我真是來錯地方了。這裡根本沒什麼強手，也沒幾個人好勝！

scripts.text:
[Martial Artist]
This whole city thinks
it can buy power and safety
with money. They don't know
the value of a nice, friendly
brawl. Hopefully, I'll find a
rival around here soon...
scripts.translation:
[武術家]
這城裡的人都覺得，錢能買來力量和安全。他們根本不懂，痛痛快快地切磋一場有多好。
希望能早點在這裡找到對手...

scripts.text:
[Kosit]
This city might have
more guards and rules
than other places, but
I still don't know if it's
really safe to live here.
scripts.translation:
[科西特]
這城裡的衛兵和規矩可能比別處都多，可我還是不知道，住這裡是不是真的安全。

scripts.text:
[Kosit]
I mean, the reason we have
these rules is because of all
the unruly gangsters that can
sometimes get into the city.
I mean, it's relatively peaceful and all. But these rules...
scripts.translation:
[科西特]
這些規矩，都是為了防那些有時會混進城裡的流氓。這裡是挺太平的，可這些規矩...

scripts.text:
[Kosit]
It's good to be safe,
but I don't know if it's
a good idea to sacrifice
our freedoms or standard
of living, you know?
scripts.translation:
[科西特]
安全是好事，可為了安全犧牲我們的自由和生活水準，真值得嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sopheap]
Oh, you youngsters.
Always traveling around
and having adventures and
fighting monsters. I certainly
had my fill of excitement back
when I was your age, long ago.
scripts.translation:
[索菲普]
哦，你們年輕人，總在到處旅行、冒險、打魔物。我像你這麼大時，也沒少經歷刺激的事。
那可是多少年前了。

scripts.text:
[Sopheap]
Sure, I miss doing all
of that, but now I'm content
with just relaxing and resting.
Still, there are a lot of old folk who refuse to sit still like this~
scripts.translation:
[索菲普]
當然，我也懷念那些日子，不過，現在能歇著放鬆就很滿足了。
可也有不少老人，不肯像我這樣安靜坐著~

scripts.text:
[Gopal]
Granny may be happy
just sitting around and
enjoying the peaceful life,
but I'm not! I'm too young
to just lay down and let
these days just pass by!
scripts.translation:
[戈帕爾]
奶奶可能覺得坐著享清福就很開心，可我不行！我還年輕，不能躺著讓日子白白過去！

scripts.text:
[Gopal]
I wanna make something
of myself. Maybe someday,
I'll found a company as big
as the Rekenber Corporation!
scripts.translation:
[戈帕爾]
我要幹出一番事業。說不定哪天，也能創辦一家跟雷肯貝爾公司一樣大的企業！

scripts.text:
[Kimmy]
Unlike most places,
Lighthalzen has many
beautiful clothing and
accessory shops. This
place is heaven to a
trend-setter like me~!
scripts.translation:
[金米]
裡希塔樂鎮和別處不同，有好多漂亮的服裝店、飾品店。
像我這樣引領潮流的人，來這裡簡直就像到了天堂~！

scripts.text:
[Kimmy]
I don't know if you
adventurers are interested
in fashion, but you can trash
your old clothes and get some
new, unique and trendy gear
over here in Lighthalzen~
scripts.translation:
[金米]
不知道你們冒險者對時尚有沒有興趣，不過，舊衣服可以扔啦！
來裡希塔樂鎮，換些新穎獨特、又時髦的行頭吧~

scripts.text:
[Bodger]
Another hungry day...
I don't have any money
and even if I did, there's
no place that sells food
I'd actually eat. Oh, man.
I'm barely living as it is.
scripts.translation:
[博傑]
又要餓一天...我沒錢，就算有，也沒地方賣我想吃的東西。
唉，能勉強活下去就不錯了。

scripts.text:
[Bodger]
I hear that the people
who live Uptown eat totally
delicious, gourmet food eight
times a day! Hopefully it's just an exaggeration. 'Cuz if it
wasn't, I'd be so mad...
scripts.translation:
[博傑]
聽說上城區的人，一天能吃八頓山珍海味！希望只是誇張的說法。
不然，我真要氣死了...

scripts.text:
[Avetis]
A-ack...
^333333*Cough cough*^000000
Would you give me
some m-medicine?!
^333333*Cough cough haack*^000000
Sweet Christmas, it hurts...

[Avetis]
I sk-skipped work
because I've been too
sick t-to go. ^333333*Cough*^000000
But now I don't have
the money to ^333333*Haack*^000000
buy med-medicine...

[Diana]
Oh wow, that weapon
is fantastic! But I'm sure
that it must be really
expensive. Huh...
scripts.translation:
[黛安娜]
哇，那武器真棒！不過，肯定貴得很吧。
唉...

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
Ma'am, are you talking
about this Stiletto? You
certainly have an eye for
quality weapons. If you
don't mind me asking,
where are you from?
scripts.translation:
[店員]
女士，您說的是這把匕首嗎？您可真會挑好武器。
冒昧問一句，您從哪裡來？

scripts.text:
[Diana]
Oh, I was born
and raised in Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[黛安娜]
哦，我是土生土長的莫洛克人。

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
Ah yes, I've heard many
good things about that town.
You've certainly proven that
people from Morocc truly have
good taste. Now, this Stiletto
is a steal at 39,800 zeny...
scripts.translation:
[店員]
啊，聽說那是個好地方。您果然證明了，莫洛克人很有品味。
這把匕首隻賣 39,800 Zeny，實在划算...

scripts.text:
[Diana]
Huh...?!
That's ridiculous!
Never mind that, let
me take a look at that
Gladius in the corner.
scripts.translation:
[黛安娜]
什麼...？！貴得太離譜了！
算了，給我看看角落裡那把短劍。

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
The Gladius?
Ah, that would be
39,800 zeny, ma'am.
scripts.translation:
[店員]
短劍？女士，那把也是 39,800 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Diana]
Oh, that's a really
good price. I'll take it!
scripts.translation:
[黛安娜]
哦，這價格真不錯。我買了！

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
Yes, this replica really
does look just like an
actual Gladius, does it
not? Although not a true
weapon, it's quite capable of
opening the toughest envelopes.
scripts.translation:
[店員]
沒錯，這件仿製品看起來跟真正的短劍一模一樣，不是嗎？
雖然不能當武器，可用來拆再難拆的信封都沒問題。

scripts.text:
[Diana]
...
......
I take that back.
This shop really sucks.
scripts.translation:
[黛安娜]
...
......
我收回剛才的話。這家店真爛。

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
Welcome to our
store where we offer
many unique products that
you can't find anywhere else.
scripts.translation:
[店員]
歡迎光臨。本店有許多獨家商品，別處可買不到。

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
However, shopping is only available to our members. There's an annual
membership fee that's waived when you spend a certain amount every
month in our store. If you invite your friends, you'll receive spe--
scripts.translation:
[店員]
不過，本店只接受會員購物。會員需要繳納年費，每月消費達到一定金額，就可免除年費。
如果邀請朋友加入，還能獲得特——

scripts.text:
[{0}]
N-no thank you!
I'm not interested!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不...不用了，謝謝！我沒興趣！

scripts.text:
[Sergei]
You know, there's an
interesting story about
the axe that's hanging
over there. Would you
like me to tell you?
scripts.translation:
[謝爾蓋]
掛在那邊的斧頭，有個有趣的故事。要不要聽我講講？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 好啊

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Sergei]
This previous owner of
this Weapon Shop was
a convicted serial killer.
Each night, he'd take that
axe and cruelly murder
beautiful ladies like me.
scripts.translation:
[謝爾蓋]
這家武器店的前任店主，是個被定罪的連環殺人犯。
每到夜裡，他就拿著那把斧頭，殘忍地殺害像我這樣美麗的女人。

scripts.text:
[Sergei]
When he was finally
caught, they beheaded
him with his own axe.
Since then, they say that
his ghost still lingers and
sharpens this axe at night.
scripts.translation:
[謝爾蓋]
他最終被抓住後，人們用他自己的斧頭砍下了他的頭。
據說，從那以後，他的鬼魂就一直徘徊不去，夜裡還會來磨這把斧頭。

scripts.text:
[Sergei]
Just thinking about
it gives me goosebumps!
And I'm supposed to work
here! It's so creepy!
scripts.translation:
[謝爾蓋]
光想想就起雞皮疙瘩！我還得在這裡工作！太嚇人了！

scripts.text:
[Sergei]
Oh, how disappointing~
It's the perfect story for
the season. Well, now that
I think about it, that story is
actually pretty creepy...
scripts.translation:
[謝爾蓋]
哦，真掃興~這個故事最適合在這季節講了。
不過，仔細想想，它確實挺嚇人的...

scripts.text:
[Srinivas]
Those rundown buildings
in the slums are an eyesore
that offend the entire city!
I just wish they would wreck
them down. What do I care
about the poor and needy?
scripts.translation:
[斯里尼瓦斯]
貧民窟那些破樓真礙眼，簡直給整座城丟臉！真希望全拆了。
那些窮人會怎麼樣？關我什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Victor Perfecto]
I've heard that the
Rekenber Corporation
actually created the
environment in Lighthalzen
through artificial means.
scripts.translation:
[維克多·佩爾費克托]
聽說裡希塔樂鎮的環境，其實是雷肯貝爾公司用人工手段營造出來的。

scripts.text:
[Victor Perfecto]
It seems like it'd take
a lot of investment, but
artificially creating an
environment isn't impossible
with the means available to
the Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[維克多·佩爾費克托]
這應該需要很大一筆投入。不過，憑雷肯貝爾公司的能力，人工營造環境也並非不可能。

scripts.text:
[Victor Perfecto]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Still, it's pretty
depressing to think
that the beauty of nature
can be man-made and
equated to zeny, you know?
scripts.translation:
[維克多·佩爾費克托]
^333333*唉...*^000000
可一想到自然之美竟能人工製造，還能用 Zeny 衡量，就覺得很沮喪，你懂嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
The weather is so
nice today, like always.
I just want to ditch work,
run outside and work out.
scripts.translation:
[維吉爾]
今天天氣還是那麼好。我真想翹班，跑到外面去鍛鍊。

scripts.text: Where do you want to go?
scripts.translation: 你想去哪裡？

scripts.text: But shouldn't you go to work?
scripts.translation: 但你不是該去上班嗎？

scripts.text: Have you heard about the serial killer?
scripts.translation: 你聽說過連環殺手嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
Well, those guys in
black suits, not to mention
the ruffians that manage to
invade town, sometimes sort
of make it kind of unsafe to
go out all by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[維吉爾]
嗯，那些穿黑西裝的傢伙，還有那些闖進鎮上的流氓，有時候讓你一個人出門確實不太安全。

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
But me and a buddy are
planning to head to the
Al De Baran Turbo Track
one of these days. Boy,
the last time we went,
he wasted a lot of zeny.
scripts.translation:
[維吉爾]
不過，我和一個朋友打算哪天去艾爾帕蘭渦輪賽道。上回去，他可是花了不少 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
He actually won some
kind of potion as a prize
and let me have it. I drank
it and it made me move really
slowly. Now what kind of prize
is that supposed to be?!
scripts.translation:
[維吉爾]
他贏了一瓶什麼藥水，就送給我了。我喝完以後，動作變得特別慢。
這到底算哪門子獎品？！

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
I think my buddy
was totally scammed.
That, or I was totally
tricked by him to drink it.
How they came up with such a ridiculous idea for a prize!
scripts.translation:
[維吉爾]
我覺得我朋友肯定被騙了。要麼，就是他騙我喝那東西。
他們怎麼會想出這麼離譜的獎品！

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
Wha--?! I didn't say
I was going to ditch work,
I just said I wanted to!
But just to spite you, maybe
just maybe, I won't go today!
scripts.translation:
[維吉爾]
什麼？！我沒說要翹班，只是說想翹班！
不過，為了氣你，說不定，我今天還真就不去了！

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
Then again, I don't
think I can slack on
this project. Curses...
The weekend certainly
doesn't come fast enough!
scripts.translation:
[維吉爾]
可話說回來，這專案還真不能偷懶。該死...
週末怎麼還不來啊！

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
What, you mean that
axe murderer from a long
time ago? Well, I heard a
rumor that it actually wasn't
like that. Let's see, how
did the story go?
scripts.translation:
[維吉爾]
什麼，你是說很久以前那個斧頭殺手？嗯，我聽說其實情況不是那樣的。讓我想想，故事是怎麼說的？

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
I heard that some hat
maker, the one who makes
the Smokie Hat, accidentally
made a Person Headgear
instead of, like, a hat made
of monsters. Don't ask me how.
scripts.translation:
[維吉爾]
聽說有個做狸貓帽子的帽匠，本來要做魔物造型的帽子，卻不小心做出了人形頭飾。
別問我是怎麼弄的。

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
Yeah, I think relatives
of that Airship Captain...
They were totally made into
a hat on accident. Supposedly,
it looks like a Reindeer Head,
but now that's just too weird.
scripts.translation:
[維吉爾]
對，好像是那位飛空艇船長的親戚...竟然被意外做成了帽子。
據說看起來像馴鹿頭，可這也太怪了。

scripts.text:
[Jorje]
Arrrgh, I don't
have any time for
talking! I'm in the
middle of an important
task! H-hold on a second!
scripts.translation:
[約爾赫]
啊...我沒時間聊天！我正在執行重要任務！等...等一下！

scripts.text:
[Jorje]
D-don't come any
closer! Anyone who
comes near me might
just screw me up! Back off!
scripts.translation:
[約爾赫]
別...別靠近！誰湊過來，都可能把我的事搞砸！退後！

scripts.text:
[Jorje]
Oh man...
I've been working so
hard and haven't taken
any breaks. I think I'll
reward myself and buy
something like maybe--
scripts.translation:
[約爾赫]
唉...我這麼賣力工作，連休息都沒有。該犒勞一下自己，買點東西，比如——

scripts.text:
[Jorje]
No! No, I'm not
gonna buy anything!
I've got my future wife
to think about! Must...
Save... More... Money!
scripts.translation:
[約爾赫]
不！不，什麼都不買！我還得為未來的妻子打算！
必須...存...更多...錢！

scripts.text:
[Leimi]
Oh...!
Good heavens!
Um, may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[萊米]
哦...！
天哪！
嗯，有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Leimi]
Oh, you're an Assassin!
Oh, you boys are soooo cute!
And so cool and so mysterious all at the same time! I love you!
scripts.translation:
[萊米]
哦，你是刺客！你們男孩子太可愛了！又酷，又神秘！我愛死你們了！

scripts.text:
[Leimi]
An Assassin...?
Oh, you wouldn't happen
to know any Assassin boys
that might be single, do you?
Oh-my-god, they're hunky-hot~
scripts.translation:
[萊米]
刺客...？你有沒有認識的單身刺客男孩？
天哪，他們又壯又帥，太迷人了~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What the...?
That sound. Did...
Did someone just
take my picture?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼...？那聲音，難道...剛才有人給我拍照？

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Welcome to the
temporary headquarters
of Cool Event Corporation.
How may I help you today?
scripts.translation:
[賽拉]
歡迎來到酷事件公司的臨時總部。今天有什麼可以幫您？

scripts.text: Temporary headquarters?
scripts.translation: 臨時總部？

scripts.text: Voting
scripts.translation: 投票

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Our headquarters building
is currently undergoing
reconstruction, so we are
basing our operations in
this place for the meantime.
scripts.translation:
[賽拉]
總部大樓目前正在改建，因此，我們暫時在這裡辦公。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Currently, Kafra Corporation
and Cool Event Corp are working
on a collaborative program that
will provide direct teleport
services to dungeons.
scripts.translation:
[賽拉]
目前，卡普拉公司與酷事件公司正在合作推出直達地下城的傳送服務。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Due to technical issues,
both companies cannot provide
teleport services to the same
dungeon. Therefore, we will be
selecting our valued customers to choose the company they want.
scripts.translation:
[賽拉]
由於技術限制，兩家公司不能同時提供前往同一地下城的傳送服務。因此，我們將挑選部分客戶，讓他們選擇希望由哪家公司提供服務。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Only a limited number of
voters will be chosen, so
you can check your voting
eligibility at the headquarters
of both participating companies. Thank you for your patronage~
scripts.translation:
[賽拉]
只有部分客戶會被選為投票者。您可以到參與合作的兩家公司總部，查詢自己是否有投票資格。
感謝您的惠顧~

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Currently, Kafra Corporation
and Cool Event Corp are working
on a collaborative program that
will provide direct teleport
services to dungeons.
scripts.translation:
[賽拉]
目前，卡普拉公司與酷事件公司正在合作推出直達地下城的傳送服務。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Due to technical issues,
both companies cannot provide
teleport services to the same
dungeon. Therefore, we will be
selecting a number of valued customers to vote for their choice.
scripts.translation:
[賽拉]
由於技術限制，兩家公司不能同時提供前往同一地下城的傳送服務。因此，我們將邀請部分客戶投票，選擇希望由哪家公司提供服務。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
I've just reviewed your
information and would like
to inform you that you are
indeed eligible to vote.
Your participation in this
election is much appreciated.
scripts.translation:
[賽拉]
剛剛核對了您的資料，您確實擁有投票資格。
非常感謝您參與此次投票。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Remember that the
election polls can be
found in either Prontera
or Juno. Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[賽拉]
請記得，投票處設在普隆德拉和朱諾。非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Thank you.
Have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[賽拉]
謝謝，祝您一天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Jellarin]
I don't like this.
But I don't like that
idea either. What will
I do for a new event, eh?
scripts.translation:
[傑拉林]
這個不喜歡，那個主意也不喜歡。新的活動到底該怎麼做呢？

scripts.text:
[Jellarin]
I need something
major, something that'll
really shake up the world,
something epochal, but what?
Hey, do you have any ideas?
scripts.translation:
[傑拉林]
我要來個大手筆，能震撼世界、開創時代的活動。可到底是什麼呢？
喂，你有沒有主意？

scripts.text:
[Baoto]
Hmmm...
The employees seem
to be having too much
fun amongst themselves
recently. This does not
bode well at all...
scripts.translation:
[包托]
嗯...最近員工們湊在一起，玩得太開心了。這可不是好兆頭...

scripts.text:
[Baoto]
It looks like I'm
just going to have to
start cracking that whip
more often and much
harder. Ha ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[包托]
看來，得更頻繁、更嚴厲地督促他們了。哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Cesuna]
Ack! I'm totally
swamped with all this
work! But I don't wanna
do any of it. That's it!
I totally need a break.
scripts.translation:
[塞蘇娜]
啊！這麼多工作，忙都忙不過來！可我一個都不想做。
決定了！我非得歇一歇不可。

scripts.text:
[Cesuna]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
I wonder if Saera
would ever consider
going out with me?
That would be nice~
scripts.translation:
[塞蘇娜]
^333333*唉...*^000000
不知道賽拉願不願意跟我約會？要是願意，該多好啊~

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Employee]
Greetings. As part of our
effort to relieve the poor,
Rekenber is providing job
opportunities targeted for
citizens of the slum areas.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾員工]
您好，為了幫助貧困居民，雷肯貝爾公司正在為貧民窟的市民提供工作機會。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Employee]
You can choose to work
from home, or undergo a
little bit of training for more
professional positions. This
is a great chance to make a
difference... and some money~
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾員工]
您可以選擇在家工作，也可以接受一些培訓，從事更專業的工作。
這是改變生活...順便賺點錢的好機會~

scripts.text:
[A Scientist]
What happened? All the machines are ruined and the research report are gone! The history of Regenschirm has been hacked!
scripts.translation:
[一位科學家]
出什麼事了？機器全毀了，研究報告也沒了！雷根席爾姆的歷史記錄遭到了駭客攻擊！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
It takes so long for
this device to process
all the data and give me
the results. Still, the wait
heightens my anticipation...
scripts.translation:
[科學家]
這臺裝置處理所有資料並給出結果需要很長時間。不過，等待反而讓我更加期待...

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
What?! Guards!
Hurry, there's an
intruder right here!
scripts.translation:
[科學家]
什麼？！衛兵！
快過來，這裡有個入侵者！
